A FEW USEFUL ANSWERS

Before your first shipment.

How much will my shipment cost?+

There is no published flat rate on this website. Tell us what you are sending and provide weight and package dimensions if available. Ask the team to confirm the charging basis, what is included, and any additional charges before booking.

How long will delivery take?+

Ask the team for the current estimate for your shipment before you book. Timing depends on the shipping method, departure schedule, cargo checks, and arrival arrangements. We do not promise an unconfirmed arrival date.

Can I ship batteries, liquids, or fragile goods?+

Tell the team exactly what the goods contain before sending them. Batteries, liquids, chemicals, fragile items, and other special cargo need a suitability check and may require specific handling. A quote request is not confirmation that an item is accepted.
